scope: React/Tauri scientific GUI: Calibration, Mask, Integration, Map, Batch, settings and sampled dialogs/editors. Scores assess design, not scientific accuracy or production readiness.
method: 25 independent categories, equal weight of 4% each. Both reviewers use these definitions and anchors. Decimal scores are allowed. No requirement to award a particular score. Codex and Claude ratings are independent, not averaged together. Earlier exploratory Claude reviews used the original ten groups.
scale: 1-3: Routine work is blocked or unreliable. 4-6: Usable, but recurring material friction or inconsistency remains. 7-8: Strong design with identifiable gaps in the reviewed workflows. 9-9.5: Polished in the reviewed workflows: key expectations met, no material defect observed in that category, only minor limitations or optional enhancements. 10: Exceptional design supported by broad empirical validation beyond this review.

criteria.name: Scientific context and provenance
criteria.criteria: Distinguish fitted, loaded, manual and derived results, their sources and diagnostic limits.
criteria.evidence: Fit controls identify values as seeds for the next fit, separately from current fitted/loaded/manual geometry. Pending option drafts and applied settings remain distinct, including project-save wording.

criteria.name: Numeric precision and units
criteria.criteria: Keep exact stored values, legible signed display values and explicit scientific units/conventions.
criteria.evidence: Exact string drafts retain signs, partial input and exponents. Fit and geometry PONI fields consistently display mm; pyFAI commands retain stored SI values through explicit conversion/no-op preservation. Frame positions explicitly use one-based bounds, unlike zero-based series indices.

criteria.name: Data visualization clarity
criteria.criteria: Make scientific scales, references, labels and color ranges interpretable without suggesting false data.
criteria.evidence: Compact movable pattern/phase legends float inside the plot without a reserved header. Low/bar/high/scale stay together; original versus overlay names and Batch indices are explicit.

criteria.name: Plot interaction and inspection
criteria.criteria: Preserve original detector resolution, square pixels, shared gestures and linked coordinates.
criteria.evidence: Alt+arrows and Alt+Home/End inspect real source samples without changing the viewport or model. Descending d spacing, hidden originals and scaled overlays are checked; original-pixel linked inspection remains covered.

criteria.name: Workflow usability
criteria.criteria: Support common analysis tasks directly and preserve meaningful work during navigation.
criteria.evidence: Fit starting values and manual/embedded geometry have App-owned session controllers. Mode changes and Escape/backdrop dismissal retain exact edits; resetting drafts does not alter applied geometry.

criteria.name: Navigation and information architecture
criteria.criteria: Use predictable mode/task grouping, persistent actions and clear navigation state.
criteria.evidence: Shared workspace-mode and history components preserve names, selection and context. Pane dividers share pointer, arrows, Shift, Home, End and reset behavior without adding visible controls.

criteria.name: Discoverability and learnability
criteria.criteria: Expose tools, gestures and explanations so users can learn without memorizing hidden actions.
criteria.evidence: One scoped shortcut reference covers implemented workspace, brush, plot, sample-inspection, legend and pane-divider keys. Pending convention markers and descriptions identify where unfinished work lives.

criteria.name: Cognitive load and progressive disclosure
criteria.criteria: Keep relevant controls visible while keeping advanced or uncommon operations manageable.
criteria.evidence: Quiet recessed fields replace pale resting outlines. Legends take no header space. Source context, unapplied edits and errors are exposed where relevant while advanced controls stay grouped.

criteria.name: Typography
criteria.criteria: Use consistent type sizes, weights, hierarchy, numerals and scientific notation.
criteria.evidence: DOM and canvas use shared text-size tokens. Standard/Larger plot labels are 14/16 px, numeric previews align consistently, and scientific minus signs/exponents and units are readable.

criteria.name: Readability and contrast
criteria.criteria: Keep labels and values readable, preserve signs, and clearly distinguish inactive controls.
criteria.evidence: Values keep their sign/order of magnitude, placeholders use an explicit readable color, and inactive/calculated states are distinct. Clear focus/error indicators remain while resting fields have no pale border.

criteria.name: Spacing and alignment
criteria.criteria: Maintain deliberate spacing, aligned labels/values, usable tables and stable action placement.
criteria.evidence: Labels, values and units stay aligned. Compact legends remain bounded and movable; measured popups, fixed task actions and scrollable editor tables are exercised in both text sizes.

criteria.name: Visual hierarchy
criteria.criteria: Let scientific data dominate while keeping state, source context and actions easy to scan.
criteria.evidence: Detector and pattern data keep the available space; legends overlay the data and fields recede visually. Orange highlights active modes/actions rather than permanent input frames.

criteria.name: Visual consistency across modes
criteria.criteria: Use the same visual rules for equivalent controls, tabs, dialogs and states.
criteria.evidence: Tabs, dialogs, field states, plot typography, legends, pane dividers, history, mode buttons, provenance and feedback share policies across modes and sampled detached views.

criteria.name: Component reuse and control semantics
criteria.criteria: Give common interface behavior one owner without losing scientific mode responsibilities.
criteria.evidence: ScientificNumberInput and numericDraft share exact display/validation; CommitNumberField commits bounded frame values, PathInput exposes long directory tails, and Fit/geometry controllers share session ownership across views. Dialogs, tabs, legends, dividers, history and modes retain common policies.

criteria.name: Dialogs and focus management
criteria.criteria: Make opening, dismissal, cancellation and focus return predictable, including nested dialogs.
criteria.evidence: Shared native modal opening, containment, Escape/backdrop dismissal and focus return work for asynchronous and explicit triggers; measured placement, larger text and error-details workflows pass in both engines.

criteria.name: Keyboard efficiency and shortcut accuracy
criteria.criteria: Make documented shortcuts operate correctly in the appropriate context without unsafe conflicts.
criteria.evidence: Documented shortcuts are exercised through real handlers with text/button/menu/dialog isolation. Plot/sample/legend/divider keys have separate scopes; sample inspection preserves data and viewport state.

criteria.name: Accessibility and inclusive use
criteria.criteria: Provide names/descriptions, semantic controls, focus visibility, text scaling and recoverable feedback.
criteria.evidence: Named generic elements now have valid roles, result counts announce updates, canvas samples expose a polite live reading, and accessibility-tree snapshots are saved. Popup target IDs are verified; an actual screen-reader session remains unvalidated.

criteria.name: System status and feedback
criteria.criteria: Show processing, pending changes, stale plots and operation outcomes accurately.
criteria.evidence: Shared transient notices, error details/copy fallback, scientific source context and pending-draft cues remain visible. Original-curve visibility/color respond immediately and reconcile with the authoritative model.

criteria.name: Validation and error prevention
criteria.criteria: Prevent incomplete or invalid edits from changing scientific state or misleading users.
criteria.evidence: Fit, geometry and frame fields share finite/range validation and descriptive field errors. Blank/partial values never coerce to zero. Real three-frame HDF5 navigation rejects invalid indices without scientific commands.

criteria.name: Error recovery
criteria.criteria: Explain failures without losing scientific work and provide a clear way to continue.
criteria.evidence: Dismissed manual-geometry drafts remain available in the shared editor. Exact fit drafts survive navigation; frame Escape restores the applied position. Existing error details/copy recovery and explicit audit failure artifacts remain covered.

criteria.name: Undo, redo and reversibility
criteria.criteria: Make the actual next history operation clear and preserve unrelated scientific diagnostics.
criteria.evidence: Shared history names/routes the actual scientific or custom action; mask Undo preserves fit diagnostics and queued Undo is retained. Geometry Reset changes only the draft; readonly inspection creates no scientific-history entry.

criteria.name: Responsive layout and text scaling
criteria.criteria: Keep controls and plots usable at supported compact sizes and both text sizes.
criteria.evidence: Batch headers wrap instead of hiding trailing actions; collapsed headers retain their controls. Active toolbar buttons are checked against every clipping ancestor and actual pointer hit targets, in addition to the compact/Larger text audits.

criteria.name: Performance and perceived responsiveness
criteria.criteria: Keep navigation and feedback responsive during scientific processing and display updates.
criteria.evidence: WebGL2 stays active, normal sample traversal uses cached coordinate order/binary lookup, and display-only inspection avoids backend edits. Quiet requests queue user intent; native GPU timing remains a separate validation limit.

criteria.name: Settings and file workflow reliability
criteria.criteria: Preserve deliberate drafts/preferences and make input/output sources and scope clear.
criteria.evidence: Drafts survive navigation, integration rebases untouched fields and projects save applied values explicitly. Loading a project/example/calibration replaces its geometry draft; existing file, phase and Batch round trips remain covered.

criteria.name: Maintainability and ownership
criteria.criteria: Centralize reusable UI policy and keep behavior reviewable and testable.
criteria.evidence: Session draft ownership is separated from rendering; common legends, dividers, history and navigation replace repeated policy. Strict unused-symbol checks and historical-renderer compatibility pass; App/PhaseEditor orchestration remains substantial.

limitations: These are subjective design ratings. They do not establish a consensus score, scientific accuracy, uncertainty estimates, usability-study results or production readiness.
Axe violations and items requiring manual review are recorded separately. Canvas accessibility and screen-reader workflows are not fully covered by automated checks.

Headless Chromium and WebKit were exercised. Native Tauri window management, OS file/color dialogs, screen readers, Windows/Linux packaging and portable Python distribution were not revalidated in this UI audit.
The gold phase file is an editor/control fixture, not an identification of the CeO2 or Fe3O4C specimens. The six-frame Batch series is derived from the CeO2 image by known intensity multipliers.
The GUI preserves existing scientific conventions, including pyFAI/Fit2D unit differences, zero-based Batch frames, a one-line footer and compact plot tools.
status: Post-reset Claude review of cc3c8704: 7.88/10. Confirmed findings are fixed; both engines passed 57 views and 33 behavior checks. Independent reassessment of the fixes is pending.

implementedImprovements.problem: Unclear scientific context and stale results
implementedImprovements.resolution: Geometry source/fit diagnostics, stale-pattern action, quantitative Map/Batch scales and source-aware series context.

implementedImprovements.problem: Clipped values and accidental provenance changes
implementedImprovements.resolution: Exact input text with compact signed previews; no-op manual Apply prevention; convention comparison retains a single pending draft and restricts editing/applying to its owner; explicit calculated read-only values.
Shared modal lifecycle, measured popup placement, roving tabs, accurate scoped shortcut help, native button/text/menu ownership and plot navigation keys.

implementedImprovements.problem: Different chrome and text rules across workflows
implementedImprovements.resolution: Neutral surface/control/type tokens shared with settings, phase editors, overlays and body popups; readable disabled/invalid/calculated states and large-text propagation. Canvas typography follows the same text preference, including readable axes and plot labels.

implementedImprovements.problem: Settings, history and feedback could lose user intent
implementedImprovements.resolution: Per-field integration draft rebase and atomic Apply; history routed by actual edit; quiet requests queue user actions; stable live regions with detailed/copyable errors and shared transient notices.

implementedImprovements.problem: Ambiguous Batch display and half-typed ranges
implementedImprovements.resolution: Explicit zero-based indices plus ordinal position, full-width docked heatmap with separate legend, measured normalization popup and committed valid integer ranges.

implementedImprovements.problem: Pale field borders and legends outside the data view consumed attention and space
implementedImprovements.resolution: Resting fields use quiet recessed fills; focus/errors remain visible. Compact pattern/phase legends float inside plots and share bounded mouse/keyboard movement.

implementedImprovements.problem: Navigation could discard unfinished geometry and scientific samples were mouse-dependent
implementedImprovements.resolution: Session-owned exact geometry drafts survive mode changes. Keyboard sample inspection reads actual values, honors visible/scaled data and leaves the view/model unchanged.

implementedImprovements.problem: Repeated shell/resize policies and unnamed generic regions weakened consistency
implementedImprovements.resolution: Shared mode/history/divider components preserve the same naming and interaction contracts. Generic named regions receive valid roles, database counts announce updates and open popup targets are checked.

implementedImprovements.problem: Independent review found zero-coerced fit seeds, discarded manual drafts and clipped Batch actions
implementedImprovements.resolution: String-preserving fit drafts, one shared geometry owner, consistent PONI mm display, explicit starting-value context, named field validation and wrapping Batch headers. Active toolbar controls are checked for clipping and hit targets.

implementedImprovements.problem: Frame edits could commit invalid positions and long paths hid their useful tail
implementedImprovements.resolution: Bounded one-based integer frame commits reject blanks/fractions; Escape restores the applied position. Long directory fields show their tail at rest and retain exact native editing and a full path title.

peer.name: Claude
peer.status: Fresh independent post-reset review; confirmed findings are being fixed and a subsequent reassessment is pending.

scoreDisplay: Overall scores are displayed to one decimal; the unrounded arithmetic mean is retained in codexMean. These are qualitative design judgments, not measured accuracy or certification.

validation.toolbarChecks: Active Batch controls are checked against ancestor clipping and actual pointer hit targets.

manualAccessibilityReview.popupControllers: Open icon-picker controllers were verified to reference an existing role=dialog target; the axe incomplete result is retained rather than relabeled as an automatic pass.
manualAccessibilityReview.emptyTables: The two empty phase/expression tables contain no scientific records. Their empty-state/form context was inspected; empty-table axe items remain visible in the raw report.
manualAccessibilityReview.remaining: Texture/image and scientific-color cases remain marked for manual contrast review. Browser semantics and live text are tested; VoiceOver/NVDA and native OS workflows are not certified.
manualAccessibilityReview.contrastScope: Computed from solid sRGB tokens using the WCAG relative-luminance formula; texture/image overlays are excluded and retained for manual review.
